description: Only in a build with downloads (the `downloads` Cargo feature, ATLAS_ENABLE_DOWNLOADS=1): the main window's commands for downloading map images and their settings, for downloading the location photos a pack lists to be fetched later, for measuring which map images of an imported map exist, for reading pages for an importer that fetches them, for reading back the style sheets kept for a game to lay its saved pages out as a browser shows them, for viewing a map page and saving its images as the person browses, and for the Sites folder of the person's site rules files (listing, adding a chosen file, removing one, keeping which are switched on, and saving the guide and the schema for writing one). No other window is granted anything.
